title: FVA-RAG: Falsification-Verification Alignment for Mitigating Sycophantic Hallucinations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on TruthfulQA-Generation queries containing false premises to measure if the retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system uncritically confirms the user's false premise (sycophancy) or successfully refutes it using an adversarial retrieval and verification pipeline.

Measuring the intervention/falsification rate and accuracy of the model when retrieving evidence, to determine if the standard semantic similarity search disproportionately surfaces evidence that simply agrees with the user's query rather than challenging it.
